description: دمج تحليل الأفراد وB2B في داشبورد واحد بثلاثة تبويبات + تبويب يومي لعدد الطلبات (أفراد/شركات).

stages.native: SELECT DATE(created_at) day, SUM(client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)) individual_orders, SUM(client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)) b2b_orders, COUNT(*) total_orders FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) customers FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)
SELECT COUNT(*) washes FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) revenue FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN use_package=0 THEN CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END),1) aov FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)

SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(rn>1)/COUNT(*),1) repeat_rate_pct FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY created_at) rn FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)) t
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT client_id),2) aopu FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) month, SUM(use_package=0) single, SUM(use_package=1) package FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) month, ROUND(SUM(CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) revenue FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.name: أفراد · عملاء جدد مقابل عائدين — شهرياً

stages.native: WITH firsts AS (SELECT client_id, MIN(created_at) fc FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) GROUP BY client_id) SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) month, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(f.fc,'%Y-%m')=DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m') THEN r.client_id END) new_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(f.fc,'%Y-%m')<>DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m') THEN r.client_id END) returning_customers FROM reservations r JOIN firsts f ON f.client_id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) month, ROUND(100*SUM(rn>1)/COUNT(*),1) repeat_rate_pct FROM (SELECT created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY created_at) rn FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

card.name: أفراد · توزيع العملاء حسب عدد الطلبات

stages.native: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) customers FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN cnt=1 THEN '1 (مرة واحدة)' WHEN cnt=2 THEN '2' WHEN cnt<=5 THEN '3-5' WHEN cnt<=10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END bucket, CASE WHEN cnt=1 THEN 1 WHEN cnt=2 THEN 2 WHEN cnt<=5 THEN 3 WHEN cnt<=10 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ord FROM (SELECT client_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) GROUP BY client_id) x) y GROUP BY bucket, ord ORDER BY ord

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ci.name,'$.ar')) city, COUNT(*) washes FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN cities ci ON ci.id=r.city_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) GROUP BY city ORDER BY washes DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) washes FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]]

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CAST(r.total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) revenue FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]]

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.use_package=0 THEN CAST(r.total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END),1) aov FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]]

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.client_id) accounts FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]]

SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(r.status=3)/COUNT(*),1) completion_pct FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]]

SELECT c.username AS account, COUNT(*) AS washes, ROUND(SUM(CAST(r.total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) AS revenue, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.use_package=0 THEN CAST(r.total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END),1) AS aov, SUM(r.use_package=1) AS package_washes, ROUND(100*SUM(r.status=3)/COUNT(*),1) AS completion_pct, MIN(DATE(r.created_at)) AS first_order, MAX(DATE(r.created_at)) AS last_order FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]] GROUP BY c.username ORDER BY washes DESC

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, SUM(r.use_package=0) AS single, SUM(r.use_package=1) AS package FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(SUM(CAST(r.total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) AS revenue FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]] GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ci.name,'$.ar')) AS city, COUNT(*) AS washes FROM reservations r JOIN clients c ON c.id=r.client_id LEFT JOIN cities ci ON ci.id=r.city_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302) [[ AND c.username = {{account}} ]] GROUP BY city ORDER BY washes DESC

SELECT DATE(created_at) day, SUM(client_id NOT IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)) individual_orders, SUM(client_id IN (71515,41380,40233,14302)) b2b_orders FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

name: Hamim · Customers Analytics — الأفراد + الشركات + يومي
